evidence_items.observed_summary: The persisted local receipt records 33 passing tests, package verification, official validation, and an outbound-free publisher dry-run while leaving remote lifecycle and submission-validity gates pending.
The bounded local parser validates authorization, confidentiality, external-processing refusal, study metadata, and emits only counts, states, guideline identifiers, and issue codes.
The packaged reference separates current venue instructions from EQUATOR-family selection and forbids treating selection as scoring or compliance proof.
The publishing guide keeps PR CI, exact-main CI, tag protection, publication, public installation, update, and fresh activation as separate future gates.

objective: Determine which local audit-venue-submission v0.2.0 confidential intake, guideline-selection, and package claims are supported before public lifecycle gates.
